general_summary: Maria Inês Costa (Belmonte, 1984) Graduated by Faculdade de Arquitectura da Universidade do Porto (FAUP) in 2008. Erasmus Programme at ENSAPB – Paris (2006-2007). Took an internership and collaborated with AVA-ARCHITECTS (2007-2009) - Porto. Collaborated in FAUP Research Center (2009) and participated at the international program Inov Contacto, at Tribuna de Arquitectura office – Barcelona (2011). In the same year, she started a partnership with Filipe Pina. Collaborated at José Manuel Soares office (2011-2012) - Porto. Currently collaborates with MFR Architectes – Paris, while developing individual projects in parallel.

general_summary: AMALGAMA is an architecture and design practice founded by Alexandre Vicente focused into changing the discourse of architecture. The practice does not only operates in a physical space, it operates in a spectrum of a network, a interconnection of sharing knowledge a practice at a virtual and physical level, we build buildings as we build networks which we call structures, the foundations of architecture itself.
